title: Isla's Puzzle Break

segments.text: Here’s today’s Sapiver Press puzzle comic.
Isla sneaks in a quick puzzle session at the kitchen table before her workday begins.
She manages to find a steady moment on her commute to focus on the grid.
A brief stop for coffee gives her a chance to look over her progress.
Check the daily rule before trusting it.
